execution_guards: Obtain separate exact irreversible approval for the frozen manifest and concrete executor; this manifest is not an executable program or permission.
Before any mutation, inspect workflow ownership, active agents and coordinator reservations; obtain an exclusive operator handoff. Use approved cable-only transport for device operations.

Check current exact Xochitl identity and service fingerprints against the retained postinventory/recovery records. Require owned clients inactive, owned adapter unmapped, and owned UI9821 listener absent. Any mismatch/unknown active actor aborts; no process stop or restart is authorized.
On the host, establish inactivity of the exact owned origin/client actors before deleting key/config/code copies. Absent listeners alone do not prove shutdown. Preserve logs and actor evidence.

Validate every planned file, directory, safe parent chain, marker, expected owner/group/mode/size and content hash before the first unlink. No broad filesystem scan or unknown-name output. Missing, linked, changed, inaccessible or unowned entries stop the operation without repair or widening.
Use bounded no-follow regular-file reads. Capture descriptor/path identity and revalidate it immediately before unlink. Never print, parse, copy or persist config/key contents.
Process exact regular files individually. Process markers last, only after child dispositions. If a planned retained/unknown child remains, retain its marker and root; do not force removal.
Attempt only explicitly listed rmdir operations, deepest-first, after verified child disposition. rmdir must refuse a nonempty directory. No rm-r, glob, recursive traversal or unknown-file deletion.
On any runtime failure or identity change, stop without automatic retry or rollback. Record already removed versus retained paths. Never claim atomic cleanup or universal secret removal.
ca_pin_note: Four device CA leaves have expected-byte pins from retained host payload. They were not newly measured on the tablet. A future approved cleanup must hash them and refuse a mismatch before unlink; no new discovery probe is requested.
